name: com.vijit101.unitymechanicsframework
description: Modular open-source gameplay mechanics framework for Unity. Plug-and-play systems for movement, dialogue, stat management, and more.

samples.description: A self-contained demo scene showing the Generic & Scalable Dialogue System with branching conversations driven by ScriptableObjects.
Interactive demo for the Stat System with Modifiers — shows flat/percentage/multiply stacking, timed debuffs, and source-based removal live with UI buttons.
